response.sql: WITH item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town) AS ratio_excess FROM town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town)

assumptions.assumption: The cross-town average ratio is the unweighted mean of the per-town average ratios (towns with a null ratio are ignored).
A derived_total_cost of 0 is treated as a missing ratio (via NULLIF) to avoid division errors.
Towns are grouped by the town_city value as stored, and the join is inner, so line items with no matching order item, order or customer are excluded.

alternatives.interpretation: The cross-town average is the mean of all per-item averages across every town (weighted by the number of order items per town), not the mean of the town averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM item GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM item) AS ratio_excess FROM town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM item)
